name: influencer.brand_unlink
description: Takes a brand off a person's links made by the import; a link a post that went out made stays, and so does one a saved post makes. Not linked, nothing changes. Answers the ids of the person's brands linked for good.
sql:
with gone as (
  delete from brandbase.influencer_brands l where l.influencer_id = :id::uuid and l.brand_id = :brand and l.source <> 'posted'
  returning l.brand_id
)
select jsonb_build_object('id', :id::uuid, 'brands', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(l.brand_id order by l.brand_id) from brandbase.influencer_brands l where l.influencer_id = :id::uuid and l.brand_id not in (select g.brand_id from gone g)), '[]'::jsonb)) as result
